svg.title: TrialMindKG deployment on AWS (Region ap-southeast-2) with NVIDIA NIM
svg.text: TrialMindKG deployment on AWS (Region ap-southeast-2) with NVIDIA NIM
Global services (top row) sit outside the Region
NVIDIA L40S and NVIDIA H100 GPUs
Visitor → Amazon CloudFront → Caddy on the EC2 instance (HTTPS). A second,
direct HTTPS address reaches Caddy without CloudFront.
Caddy → FastAPI container → SQLite card index: pages, cards, search,
FastAPI → NVIDIA NIM chat models (HTTPS, OpenAI format): typed question →
validated openCypher; answer summary; sentence check; on-demand
'Run this on Amazon Neptune': FastAPI → Neptune openCypher over HTTPS port
8182; if Neptune is asleep, the wake timer calls start-db-cluster
At boot the instance reads the NVIDIA key (encrypted) from Parameter Store
and syncs the bundle, data and index parts from Amazon S3.
Neptune idle stop: CloudWatch alarm → Lambda → stop; EventBridge Scheduler
30-minute sweep → Lambda; nightly stop at 23:00 IST, cron(30 17 * * ? *)
EC2 status alarm → SNS → owner's e-mail; AWS Budgets → owner's e-mail
Owner's Mac uploads bundle, index parts, downloads and load files to S3;
the Neptune bulk loader reads S3 through the VPC endpoint; Run Command
Owner's Mac launches the instance with user data (EC2 API); IAM roles
grant each part only its own permissions.
Owner's Mac → NVIDIA GPU host (graphs in, result files out); Owner's Mac →
NIM embed, rerank and rater models.
